events.label: birth
events.text: Engelbert Endrass born, later German U-boat commander

evidence.quote: ( 2 March 1911 – 21 December 1941 ) was a German U-boat commander

undated_mentions: Served some months on a cruiser and on escort ships after April 1935
Sank a British auxiliary cruiser on his first patrol with U-46
Second patrol with U-46: sank five more ships, including another British auxiliary cruiser
Attack on Convoy SC 7 with six other U-boats, sinking ships
Attack on Convoy HX 79, sinking two ships
Painted the bull emblem on all subsequent U-boats he served on
